newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangzhou Inv in 320 mln new share issue.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Inv in 320 mln new share issue.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd plans to issue 320 million new shares at HK$3.98 each to its parent after the parent placed the same number of existing shares to private investors, a spokeswoman said on Thursday.
Yue Xiu Enterprises (Holdings) Ltd was placing 320 million existing shares in Guangzhou Investment and will subscribe the same number of new shares from the company, the spokeswoman said.
"The money raised will be used to acquire hotels in Guangzhou and as working capital for the group," she said.
She declined to comment further on the planned purchases. The company was working on details of the deals and a statement would be issued later on Thursday, she said.
"The placing is being done by Peregrine," she added.
Shares of Guangzhou Investment closed at HK$4.15 on Thursday, up HK$0.25, or 6.41 percent.
